entries.en: The actionless figure in the doorway made her hesitate.
entries.zh: 门口那个静止不动的身影让她犹豫了。

entries.en: The experiment compared the activatory effects of the two extracts.
entries.zh: 实验比较了两种提取物的活化作用。

entries.en: The workshop welcomed active-duty personnel as well as retired officers.
entries.zh: 这次研讨活动既欢迎现役人员，也欢迎退役军官参加。

entries.en: She laughed at her own actressy gesture and sat down.
entries.zh: 她笑了笑自己那女演员般的姿态，然后坐了下来。

entries.en: The drawing showed an aculeiform projection beside the smooth edge.
entries.zh: 图上在光滑的边缘旁画着一个皮刺状的突起。

entries.en: Her acuminous observations exposed a weakness in the critic's argument.
entries.zh: 她敏锐的观察揭示了那位评论家论证中的一个薄弱之处。

entries.en: She traced the outline of the acuminulate leaf with a pencil.
entries.zh: 她用铅笔沿着那片细尖叶子的轮廓描画。

entries.en: He drew an acute-angled triangle in the margin of his notebook.
entries.zh: 他在笔记本的页边画了一个锐角三角形。

entries.en: The hospital advertised three nursing positions in its acute-care unit.
entries.zh: 医院公布了急性病治疗病区的三个护理岗位。

entries.en: The gardener chose an acutifoliate shrub for the botanical illustration.
entries.zh: 园丁选了一株尖叶灌木作为植物插图的描绘对象。

entries.en: The physician described the patient as acyanotic in the admission notes.
entries.zh: 医生在入院记录中将这位患者描述为不发绀。

entries.en: The chemists tested two acylable compounds under identical conditions.
entries.zh: 化学研究人员在相同条件下测试了两种可酰化的化合物。

entries.en: I chose the ad-supported version because the monthly fee was too high.
entries.zh: 由于月费太高，我选择了由广告支持的版本。

entries.en: The lecturer discussed Adamic imagery in the poem's opening section.
entries.zh: 讲师讨论了这首诗开篇部分的亚当意象。

entries.en: She checked the label before buying the additive-free apple juice.
entries.zh: 她查看标签后，才买下那瓶无添加剂的苹果汁。

entries.en: An additory clause at the end extended the agreement by one month.
entries.zh: 末尾的一项附加条款将协议期限延长了一个月。

entries.en: The emulator failed when it encountered an address-modifiable instruction.
entries.zh: 模拟器遇到一条地址可变的指令时发生了故障。

entries.en: The historian distinguished adduceable evidence from rumours repeated without a source.
entries.zh: 历史学家将可引证的证据与没有来源却被反复传播的传闻区分开来。

entries.en: The surviving letters provide adducible evidence for her account of the journey.
entries.zh: 留存的信件为她对那次旅程的叙述提供了可引证的证据。

entries.en: The biologist sketched an adendric neuron beside her microscope.
entries.zh: 那位生物学家在她的显微镜旁画了一个无树突的神经元。

entries.en: The student shaded the adeniform structure in the anatomical illustration.
entries.zh: 学生给解剖插图中的腺状结构画上了阴影。

entries.en: The botanist examined the adenophyllous specimen with a hand lens.
entries.zh: 植物学家用手持放大镜检查了那份具腺叶的标本。

entries.en: The technician prepared a thin section of the adenose tissue.
entries.zh: 技术员将那块有腺的组织制成了薄切片。

entries.en: The worksheet asks students to identify the adessive ending in each sentence.
entries.zh: 练习要求学生找出每个句子中的位置格词尾。

entries.en: The laboratory measured adhesional forces between the two polished surfaces.
entries.zh: 实验室测量了两个抛光表面之间的粘附力。

entries.en: The conservator held the adiaphanous stone against a bright lamp.
entries.zh: 文物修复人员把那块不透光的石头对着一盏明亮的灯。

entries.en: The diagram represents the chamber wall as an adiathermal barrier.
entries.zh: 图中将腔室壁表示为一道绝热屏障。

entries.en: The test beam was directed at an adiathermanous screen.
entries.zh: 测试光束被引向一块不透红外线的屏。

entries.en: The magazine promised subscribers an adless edition with longer interviews.
entries.zh: 杂志向订阅者承诺提供无广告且访谈篇幅更长的版本。

entries.en: The investigator treated the receipt as adminicular evidence rather than decisive proof.
entries.zh: 调查人员将那张收据视为辅助证据，而不是决定性的证明。

entries.meaningZh: 补充性的；辅助性的〔正式〕
entries.en: Her notes offered adminiculary support for the chronology in the report.
entries.zh: 她的笔记为报告中的事件年表提供了补充性的支持。

entries.en: The administrant checked the inventory before locking the office for the night.
entries.zh: 管理人在晚上锁好办公室之前核对了物品清单。

entries.en: His admonitorial letter urged the apprentices to arrive on time.
entries.zh: 他在那封劝告信中敦促学徒们准时到达。

entries.en: The editor removed an unnecessary adnominal modifier from the sentence.
entries.zh: 编辑从句中删去了一个不必要的修饰名词的成分。

entries.en: He lay adream while rain tapped against the bedroom window.
entries.zh: 雨点敲打卧室窗户时，他躺着做梦。

entries.en: The pathologist requested another slide showing the adrenic tissue.
entries.zh: 病理学家要求再提供一张展示肾上腺组织的切片。

entries.en: The protocol excluded compounds with adrenocorticomimetic activity from the comparison.
entries.zh: 实验方案将具有类皮质激素活性的化合物排除在比较之外。

entries.en: The syllabus includes a seminar on adrenogenital disorders and their terminology.
entries.zh: 教学大纲安排了一次关于肾上腺生殖器疾病及其术语的研讨课。

entries.en: The umbrellas stood adrip beside the crowded restaurant's front door.
entries.zh: 那些湿淋淋的雨伞立在拥挤的餐厅前门旁。

entries.en: After the long walk, he was adry and asked for water.
entries.zh: 走了很长一段路后，他口渴了，便要了些水。

entries.en: An adscendent branch crossed the lower edge of the window.
entries.zh: 一根向上伸展的枝条横过了窗户的下缘。

entries.en: The adstringent wine left her mouth feeling dry after one sip.
entries.zh: 那种涩嘴的葡萄酒让她喝了一口就觉得口腔发干。

entries.en: Her adult-like composure surprised everyone during the noisy family argument.
entries.zh: 在那场吵闹的家庭争执中，她像成人般沉着，令所有人都感到意外。

entries.en: The station replaced its youth programme with an adult-oriented music show.
entries.zh: 电台用一档面向成人的音乐节目替换了原来的青年节目。

entries.en: The cinema moved its adult-rated films to the late evening slot.
entries.zh: 影院把面向成人的影片改排到了晚间较晚的时段。

entries.en: We followed an adumbral path away from the sunlit courtyard.
entries.zh: 我们沿着一条成荫的小路，离开了阳光照耀的庭院。

entries.en: The illustrator gave the bird an adunc bill and broad wings.
entries.zh: 插画师给那只鸟画了一个向内弯曲的喙和宽大的翅膀。

entries.en: An aduncate hook caught the loose thread near the hem.
entries.zh: 一个向内弯曲的钩子勾住了衣服下摆附近的松线。

entries.en: The model's aduncous claws curled around the edge of the display stand.
entries.zh: 模型上向内弯曲的爪子扣住了展示架的边缘。

entries.en: Above the old fireplace, the plaster bore an adustous stain.
entries.zh: 旧壁炉上方的灰泥表面有一片煤烟色的污迹。

entries.en: The researchers compared advectional transport with local mixing in the model.
entries.zh: 研究人员比较了模型中的平流输送与局地混合。

entries.en: Their adventureful journey ended with a quiet supper at the inn.
entries.zh: 他们那段充满惊险的旅程以在客栈里安静地吃了一顿晚饭而告终。

entries.en: She pressed an adversifoliate sprig between two sheets of blotting paper.
entries.zh: 她把一段具对生叶的小枝夹在两张吸水纸之间压平。

entries.en: The manager wanted an advertisable product ready before the trade fair.
entries.zh: 经理希望在贸易展开始前准备好一款可以宣传的产品。

entries.en: The beetle's aedeagal structure was drawn at a larger scale.
entries.zh: 那只甲虫的阳茎结构以更大的比例绘制出来。

entries.en: The beetle's aeneous wing cases gleamed beneath the desk lamp.
entries.zh: 那只甲虫青铜色的鞘翅在台灯下闪着光。

entries.en: The painter added an aenescent wash to the figure's helmet.
entries.zh: 画家在人物的头盔上罩染了一层铜色。

entries.en: The engraver drew two aequilate bands around the border.
entries.zh: 雕刻师在边框周围画了两道等宽的条带。

entries.en: She cut an aequilateral triangle from a sheet of blue card.
entries.zh: 她从一张蓝色卡纸上剪出了一个等边三角形。

entries.en: The vase had an aereous sheen under the gallery lights.
entries.zh: 那个花瓶在展厅灯光下泛着青铜色的光泽。

entries.en: The team measured aeroacoustic noise around the model in the wind tunnel.
entries.zh: 团队在风洞中测量了模型周围的空气声学噪声。

entries.en: The exhibition included a model of an aeroamphibious vehicle.
entries.zh: 展览中有一个海陆空交通工具的模型。

entries.en: The laboratory kept the aeroanaerobic culture separate from the other samples.
entries.zh: 实验室将那份需氧兼厌氧的培养物与其他样本分开放置。

entries.en: The engineers revised the aeroballistic model after the second test.
entries.zh: 工程师们在第二次试验后修改了空气弹道学模型。

entries.en: The researcher labelled the aerobian culture before placing it in the incubator.
entries.zh: 研究人员给那份需氧培养物贴上标签，然后放进培养箱。

entries.en: They added an aerobiological sampling station to the laboratory rooftop.
entries.zh: 他们在实验室屋顶增设了一个大气生物学采样站。

entries.en: Her aerodynamical analysis prompted a change to the racing car's rear wing.
entries.zh: 她的空气动力学分析促成了对赛车尾翼的修改。

entries.en: High-speed footage revealed aeroelastic deformation of the test wing.
entries.zh: 高速影像显示了试验机翼的空气弹性变形。

entries.en: The survey crew checked the aeroelectromagnetic equipment before takeoff.
entries.zh: 勘测组在起飞前检查了航空电磁设备。

entries.en: The microbiologist selected an aerogenic culture for the next experiment.
entries.zh: 微生物学家选了一份产气的培养物用于下一项实验。

entries.en: The report compares the aerogenous activity of the two cultures.
entries.zh: 报告比较了两份培养物的产气活性。

entries.en: The engineer collected an aerohydrous mixture from the damaged pipe.
entries.zh: 工程师从损坏的管道中收集了一份含空气与水的混合物。

entries.en: The course combines aeromechanical analysis with practical wind-tunnel work.
entries.zh: 这门课程把航空力学分析与风洞实操结合起来。

entries.en: The laboratory installed an aerometric instrument beside the ventilation duct.
entries.zh: 实验室在通风管道旁安装了一台量气仪器。

entries.en: The cadets studied an aeronaval exercise on the classroom map.
entries.zh: 军校学员们借助教室里的地图研究了一次海空联合演习。

entries.en: The grant funded an aeronomic study of the upper atmosphere.
entries.zh: 这笔资助支持了一项高层大气物理学研究。

entries.en: The chapter introduces aerostatic pressure before discussing moving air.
entries.zh: 本章先介绍气体静力学压力，再讨论流动的空气。

entries.en: His aerostatical calculations filled several pages of the engineer's notebook.
entries.zh: 工程师的笔记本上有好几页写满了他的空气静力学计算。

entries.en: An oxygen gradient altered the bacteria's aerotactic response in the chamber.
entries.zh: 腔室内的氧浓度梯度改变了细菌的趋氧反应。

entries.en: The aerothermal calculations were repeated after the flight vehicle's shape changed.
entries.zh: 飞行器形状改变后，气动热计算又做了一遍。

entries.en: The technician compared aerotolerant strains in open and sealed containers.
entries.zh: 技术员比较了开放和密封容器中的耐氧菌株。

entries.en: An aeruginous stain marked the stone beneath the copper ornament.
entries.zh: 铜饰下方的石头上有一块铜绿色的污迹。

entries.en: An Aesopic fable opens the collection with an argument between animals.
entries.zh: 一篇伊索寓言式的故事以动物之间的争论拉开了这部故事集的序幕。

entries.en: The report combines the aestivo-autumnal observations in a single table.
entries.zh: 报告把夏秋两季的观测结果合并在一张表中。

entries.en: The aethereal fabric stirred whenever someone opened the dressing-room door.
entries.zh: 每当有人打开更衣室的门，那块轻飘的织物就会拂动。

entries.meaningZh: 轻飘的；空气一般的〔罕用〕
entries.en: The dancer's aetherial movements contrasted with the heavy beat of the drums.
entries.zh: 舞者轻飘的动作与沉重的鼓点形成了对比。

entries.en: His affectionated farewell softened the disappointment of their early departure.
entries.zh: 他深情的告别缓和了他们提前离去带来的失望。

entries.en: His affectionless reply brought their brief conversation to an end.
entries.zh: 他无情的回答结束了他们简短的交谈。

entries.en: The essay traces affinitive links between the two musical traditions.
entries.zh: 这篇文章追溯了两种音乐传统之间的密切联系。

entries.en: The debate over affirmative-action policies continued long after the meeting ended.
entries.zh: 会议结束很久后，人们仍在争论平权行动政策。

entries.en: The instructor contrasted affricative sounds with fricative sounds during the lesson.
entries.zh: 老师在课上对比了塞擦音与擦音。

entries.en: His affrontive remark silenced the guests gathered around the table.
entries.zh: 他那句侮辱人的话让围坐桌旁的客人们安静了下来。

entries.en: The technician checked the afocal attachment before mounting it on the camera.
entries.zh: 技术员检查了无焦点附件，然后把它装到相机上。

entries.en: The sketch shows an afoliate branch against the winter sky.
entries.zh: 素描画出了一根以冬日天空为背景的无叶枝条。

entries.en: Please send the afore-mentioned forms to the address on the envelope.
entries.zh: 请将上述表格寄到信封上的地址。

entries.meaningZh: 上述的；前面所列的〔正式〕
entries.en: The aforecited report includes two maps missing from the later edition.
entries.zh: 上述报告包含两幅后来版本中缺失的地图。

entries.meaningZh: 上举的；上述提及的〔正式〕
entries.en: All aforenamed participants will receive a copy of the meeting notes.
entries.zh: 所有上述提及的参与者都会收到一份会议记录。

entries.en: An African-Caribbean artist designed the mural beside the library entrance.
entries.zh: 一位非裔加勒比艺术家设计了图书馆入口旁的壁画。

entries.en: The quartet added Afro-Cuban rhythms to the final piece of the concert.
entries.zh: 四重奏乐团在音乐会的最后一首乐曲中加入了古巴黑人文化的节奏元素。

entries.en: The seminar compared noun patterns in several Afroasiatic languages.
entries.zh: 研讨会比较了几种亚非语系语言的名词模式。
